description.value: A family-run boutique winery on Summerland's Bottle Neck Drive, producing small-batch wines from 100% BC VQA grapes grown in the volcanic soils of Giant Head Mountain. The property features a cozy log-cabin tasting room and an outdoor picnic area with a fountain where visitors are encouraged to bring a lunch and relax. A good rest stop for touring cyclists riding the Summerland wine route.

address.value: 8001 Happy Valley Road, Summerland, BC V0H 1Z4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active boutique winery in Summerland on the Bottle Neck Drive wine route, with a tasting room, outdoor picnic area with fountain, and wine shop.
